requirements.description: Annual Compustat inputs for actual and estimated CFO, production costs, discretionary expense components, equity value/book value, earnings, assets, sales, inventories and SIC-based annual industry groups.

required_coverage.population: US Compustat firms in the paper’s 1987–2001 firm-year population, excluding regulated industries and financial institutions
required_coverage.detail: Computed from 1987–2001 anchor years; the normal-production support model contains ΔS_{t−1}, which requires S_{t−2}; earliest raw year is 1985. Scaled t and t−1 denominators remain included.

routes.mapping_notes: Candidate construction for this requirement uses cataloged COMP.FUNDA fields gvkey, datadate, fyear, sich, at, oancf, cfo, sale, revt, cogs, invt, ib, prcc_f, csho, ceq, seq, xrd, xad, xsga, capx, act. Fields are live-column evidence only; paper units, fiscal period, adjusted basis and field-to-item semantics are assessed separately for: Annual Compustat inputs for actual and estimated CFO, production costs, discretionary expense components, equity value/book value, earnings, assets, sales, inventories and SIC-based annual industry groups. Within-table keys use GVKEY and fiscal year; no external equity return link is required by the frozen fits.
routes.coverage_notes: No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation was supplied. The bounded probe establishes readable fields only; it does not confirm historical or population coverage.

requirements.unresolved_reason: Local source is cataloged and exact fields are probed, but historical/population coverage has no frozen coordinator confirmation. Semantic mapping/product alignment remains unverified for the paper definition.
